_comment: P0 containment (T03). Entries may only be added by an authorized legal reviewer, out-of-band, with their own reviewer_id, an exact content_hash of the specific text version being approved, and status set to active. A text change invalidates the hash and the approval fails closed automatically. Set status to revoked (and revoked_at) to withdraw an approval; never delete the historical record.
